result.title: EvoX: Rethinking the Agent Harness as a Runtime Policy
result.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly interact with tools and environments, yet plausible model decisions do not always translate into successful execution due to tool-call mismatches, interrupted workflows, and unsupported completion claims. We present EvoX, a Rust-based, multi-model agent runtime guided by The Second Policy, which views the harness as an Operational Policy complementing the foundation model's Semantic Policy. EvoX combines model-facing guidance with deterministic runtime control through three complementary mechanisms: Action Realization, Execution Continuity, and Outcome Grounding. To evaluate harnesses without suppressing their native behaviors, we introduce Contrast, a controlled and auditable framework integrating explicit fairness constraints, provider-bound request verification, and evidence-based adjudication. Across five benchmarks, six foundation models, and six agent harnesses, EvoX achieves the highest numerical success rate of 56.2% over 691 common task--model pairs, exceeding the average of the other five harnesses by approximately 3.0 percentage points. Its larger advantages on GLM-5.3 (+10.7 points) and Kimi K3 (+7.9 points) highlight the model-dependent effectiveness of harness design and the potential for cross-provider adaptability. Achieved without memory, evolution, or extensions, these results establish EvoX as a competitive multi-model agent runtime and underscore the importance of harness-level operational control in realizing foundation-model capabilities.

AI.brief_summary: EvoX 是一个 Rust 实现的多模型 agent runtime，把 harness 视为补充模型语义策略的「运行策略」，通过 Action Realization、Execution Continuity、Outcome Grounding 三种机制做确定性运行时控制，并提出 Contrast 评测框架，在五个基准、六个模型上取得 56.2% 的最高成功率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其 Outcome Grounding 与对「未获支持的完成声明」的抑制，可能为 LVR 中答案是否真正落地、何时应停止（STOP）提供外部校验与评价思路；但该方法属工程层运行时控制，不涉及视觉状态或 latent 表示，迁移价值需核查。
